critical_code_review_comments: VenueDashboard.jsx is now ~420 lines with 3 sub-components (ReportView, CampaignView, Stat) — still readable but approaching the split threshold; consider extracting CampaignView + ReportView into separate files under src/pages/venue/ for future maintainability.

CampaignView.generate() issues N sequential POST /api/venue/codes calls (one per number). For 100 numbers this is 100 round trips — consider a bulk endpoint POST /api/venue/codes/bulk that accepts an array of {couple_name} entries and returns N codes atomically. Not blocking, but improves UX for larger campaigns.

TrDatePicker forces onChange(toISO(date)) but does not guard against undefined date (react-day-picker calls onSelect(undefined) when deselecting the same day) — toISO('') returns '' so it's safe today, but adding `if (!date) return;` would prevent accidental clear.

wa.me template in CampaignView uses INVITE_URL from window.location.origin — fine for preview, but if invitations are meant to be shared with a canonical domain the template should use a configurable base URL from env.
